doc.name: By Earth and Ocean Noosa tour bookings
doc.instructions: Book tours in Noosa, Australia with By Earth and Ocean: guided and self guided kayak tours to see stingrays in the Noosa Everglades, e-bike and mountain bike tours, and fat bike beach rides; and Bike On bike rentals with delivery. Use list_tours (or list_rentals and check_rental_availability for bike hire), then check_availability for a date. To book, either give the customer the booking_link, or use get_booking_form then create_booking: the booking is unpaid and the customer pays with the payment link. Never ask for card details. Prices are AUD.

tools.name: list_tours
tools.title: List tours
tools.description: List By Earth and Ocean tours in Noosa (kayak tours on the Noosa Everglades with stingrays, guided and self guided e-bike and mountain bike tours, fat bike beach rides). Returns each tour key, description, page and its session times.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.title: Check tour availability
tools.description: Live places and prices for one tour on one date, straight from the booking system. Returns each session that can be booked, places left, total price for the group, the guest types it takes, and a booking link the customer can open to book themselves.

tour.description: Tour key, as listed by list_tours

adults.description: Adults (on kayak tours: anyone 13 and over)

children.description: Children (kayak tours: ages 4 to 12). Bike tours have no child rate.

infants.description: Infants and toddlers aged 3 and under (kayak tours)

guests.description: Optional: exact counts by the guest_types keys that check_availability returns. Overrides adults/children/infants.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.title: List rental bikes
tools.description: List Bike On bike rentals in Noosa (e-bike cruisers, fat tyre e-bikes, mountain and e-mountain bikes, road and gravel bikes, kids and family bikes). Each bike shows its sizes with the rider height each size suits. Delivery areas and minimums are included.

tools.name: check_rental_availability
tools.title: Check rental availability
tools.description: Live availability and price for Bike On rental bikes over a date range, by size item_id, plus the delivery charge if a suburb is given. Each size suits a range of rider heights.

inputSchema.description: For Bike On bike rentals instead of a tour.

end_date.description: Last day of hire, YYYY-MM-DD (same as start_date for one day)

delivery_suburb.description: Optional: suburb to deliver to and collect from. Leave out to collect from the shop.

children.description: Children (kayak tours: ages 4 to 12). Bike tours have no child rate.

infants.description: Infants and toddlers aged 3 and under (kayak tours)

guests.description: Optional: exact counts by the guest_types keys that check_availability returns. Overrides adults/children/infants.

rental.description: For Bike On bike rentals instead of a tour.

end_date.description: Last day of hire, YYYY-MM-DD (same as start_date for one day)

delivery_suburb.description: Optional: suburb to deliver to and collect from. Leave out to collect from the shop.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.title: Hold a booking (unpaid, 30 minutes)
tools.description: Book a tour session or Bike On rental for the customer. The booking is made unpaid and holds the places for 30 minutes; the customer must pay with the payment link returned, on our secure booking page (no card details are ever taken here). Unpaid bookings are cancelled automatically. Needs the customer's confirmation of the details and their agreement to the booking terms.

customer_agreed_to_terms.description: True only if the customer has read and agreed to the booking terms

customer_confirmed_details.description: True only if the customer confirmed tour, date, time, numbers and price
